name: Prague University of Economics
description: Prague University of Economics and Business, formerly known as the University of Economics in Prague, which is the largest public university in the Czech Republic in the field of economics and business, was established in 1953. While 5 of the 6 faculties within the university are located in the capital Prague; The Faculty of Management is located in Jindřichův Hradec. Prague University of Economics and Business, which currently has 14,000 students enrolled, is accredited by EQUIS. Thanks to this accreditation, the "Business Administration" faculty of the university is shown in the 1% of the world.
